user.title: Add a ViewSonic ViewBoard
user.description: Enter the board's IP address. Network control (port 5000) must be reachable from Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to port 5000 at that address. Check the IP and that the board is on.
error.not_viewboard: Something answered on port 5000, but it did not respond like a ViewBoard.

abort.already_configured: This ViewBoard is already added. Its IP address has been updated.
abort.wrong_device: That IP address belongs to a different ViewBoard.

init.title: Networks to search
init.description: When this board's IP address changes, Home Assistant searches its own network and the /24 around each board's last address. If boards are on a different network from Home Assistant and can move further than that, list their networks here, e.g. 10.3.12.0/22. These networks are searched for every ViewBoard.

error.invalid_network: Enter private IPv4 networks such as 10.3.12.0/22, each no larger than a /20 (4,096 addresses).
